findings.F1: The tested slope is on the side the idea predicts but just short of the bar (pooled t = 1.96 over 2443 non-overlapping 7-day cases), and the same positive slope appears at shorter horizons (t = 4.33 at 1 day over 17380 cases, t = 3.19 at 3 days over 5723) while it fades at longer ones (t = 1.32 at 14 days, t = 0.29 at 28 days), so the 7-day test sits where the effect is thinning.
findings.F2: The 7-day effect is weak and uneven across coins and years: per-coin t runs from -0.14 (ETH) and -0.05 (XMR) to 1.61 (XRP) and 1.55 (ZEC), and per-year t runs from -0.79 (2018) to 3.04 (2024), with 2018, 2019 and 2023 negative, so no coin or year shows it clearly on about 300–400 cases each.
findings.F3: The plain effect sits mostly at the extremes of the forecast: the thinnest-volume quintile averages -0.87% excess 7-day return and the heaviest +0.58%, while the middle three quintiles lie between -0.04% and +0.31%.
findings.F4: The effect shows on up days and is mixed on down days: on bars that closed up the slope t is 2.19 (n = 1215), and terciles of relative volume give -0.47%, +0.94% and +1.65% excess 7-day return, while on down days t is 1.36 (n = 1084) and the terciles are non-monotone (-2.01%, +0.22%, -0.92%).
findings.F5: Relative volume signed by the day's direction predicts more clearly than relative volume alone: its 7-day slope t is 2.94 (n = 2299) and its 14-day t is 3.33 (n = 1008), it is positive in all 6 coins at 7 days (t 0.11 to 2.08) and in 7 of 8 years, and its sextiles rise from -0.83% to +1.76% excess 7-day return.

ideas.name: volume surge, more coins
ideas.idea: The higher a coin's traded volume over the past day relative to its average over the past 20 days, the higher its return over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: A rise in volume would favour holding a coin long over the next week, and unusually thin volume would be a reason to stay out.

ideas.idea: The higher a coin's traded volume over the past day relative to its average over the past 20 days, the higher its return over the next 7 days, only on a day the coin closed higher than the day before.
ideas.consequence: A heavy-volume up day would favour holding the coin long over the next week, more so the heavier the volume, while a thin-volume up day would give no such reason.
ideas.name: heavy volume on up days

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's traded volume over the past day relative to its average over the past 20 days, taken with the sign of that day's return, the higher its return over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would lean long a coin after a heavy-volume rise and away from it after a heavy-volume fall, in proportion to how unusual the day's volume was.
ideas.name: direction-signed volume surge
